name: photo-revival
title_zh: 把随手拍变成留白诗意手绘插画
tagline_zh: 厌倦了滤镜和美颜？这张照片想要的是被画下来。大留白、局部色彩、拼贴小纸片、手写小字——像寄自旧时光的明信片。
tagline_en: Tired of filters and beauty modes? This photo wants to be drawn, not edited. Big white space, local color.
desc_en: Turn ordinary photos or everyday snapshots into poetic hand-drawn illustrations with large white-paper negative space, vivid localized color, subtle collage accents, and tiny handwritten captions. Use when a user wants a real photo reimagined as an illustration rather than filtered, beautified, or photorealistically edited.
why_zh: 不是风格迁移，是重新构图：先抽掉背景杂物，再按诗意逻辑分配留白与色块，最后手工拼贴。
why_en: Not style transfer—it recomposes first: strips clutter, redistributes white space and color by poetic logic, then adds collage.
limit_zh: 只处理单张照片，不批量；需要原图有至少一个清晰主体（人/物/景），纯风景或极暗光会退化成空白纸。输出为PNG插画。
limit_en: Single photo only, no batch. Needs one clear subject (person/object/scene); pure landscapes or very low light degrade to blank paper. Output is PNG.
title_en: Turn snapshots into poetic hand-drawn illustrations
